snippet.title: 3 Lines of a Delta | Trailer
snippet.description:
Animation: kiviont
Composer: @zionmuzyk_zion

A BL Visual Novel
Release Date: 3 March 2026
Story Summary:
Lennox and Dawid have been avoiding each other after an incident that resulted in Witold being beaten and admitted to the hospital. Three years after that turning point in their lives, Lennox decides to approach Dawid in an attempt to mend their severed bond—much to Dawid’s horror.

Content warnings: shaking screen, mild violence and mentions of suicide. Player discretion is advised.
